mathematica.method: Local Wolfram MCP; random projection two-invariant contraction, exact algebra and Beta integrals. Wolfram Context reported missing LLMKit subscription but the local evaluator worked; no cloud computation used.

proof_audit.a_gradient: For h(sigma)=Tr sqrt(sqrt(rho)(I/k tensor sigma)sqrt(rho)), derivative at sigma0,a=m_a/D I equals Tr_Q sqrt(rho_a)/(2k sqrt(m_a/(kD))). Concave tangent gives h<=h0/2+max_a||G_a||inf. Rank-deficient rho is handled on its support.
proof_audit.a_partial_trace: For q=kn, bounded Hermitian H, h_v(U)=Tr[(I_k tensor |v><v|)UHU*]/k has Hilbert-Schmidt Lipschitz constant <=2||H||inf/sqrt(k). Meckes concentration and a complex 1/4-net of size <=9^(2n) give tail <=2 exp[(2 log9-C²/192)n] for norm threshold 2C||H||inf/k, for kn sufficiently large. No condition n/k² is needed.
proof_audit.a_growth: When both Fibonacci sides grow and k phi^(NB-NR) tends to positive finite lambda, k/D=O(1/n_1²)->0. Gaussian/Stiefel purification distance is o_P(1). Condition on Wishart eigenvalues, apply Haar partial-trace concentration to sqrt(W), then combine MP trace limit with the tangent bound. This controls the optimal decoder and bounded fidelity gives mean convergence.
proof_audit.b_petz: Direct Kraus composition matches F_P=k^-2 sum_a Tr[(Tr_Q sqrt(H_a* H_a))²]. Kernel completion is CPTP and has no effect on channel inputs.
proof_audit.b_dual: With normalized Choi J, primal trace_Q X=I_m/k and dual objective sum Tr Y/k. Y_a=||M_a||inf sqrt(S_a)/k is feasible after whitening; nonzero Gram eigenvalues are those of M_a/k.
proof_audit.b_fixed_k: Haar twirl residual exactly zero. Conditional eigenvector integration gives P_k(c)=k^-2+(1-k^-2)f(c), and F_P<=F_rec<=sqrt(F_P) gives a strict mean converse at every finite c. The other trace-distance bound closes the low endpoint at k^-2.
proof_audit.b_growth: Relative squared Hilbert-Schmidt fluctuation tends to (n_a/k²)(1-f)/f. Hence n_a/k²->0 closes the explicit dual bound. The Stiefel perturbation relative error is O_P(epsilon sqrt(n_a)), not O_P(epsilon n_a); with D asymp k n_a² and epsilon=O_P(sqrt((k+logD)/D)) it vanishes.
proof_audit.boundary: Full-space coding has optimal fidelity sum m_a²/D². NB=2 gives c0=sqrt5/phi³. A both-growing sequence with the same Xi reaches f(c0)<c0, with strictness from MP nonzero-spectrum duality and Jensen. Both submitted integer constructions are admissible asymptotically.

reproduction_method.haar: iid complex Gaussian QR, columns multiplied by diagonal(R)/abs(diagonal(R))
reproduction_method.contractions: Enumerate every Q,R,B index in the four unitary Weingarten Kronecker contractions using fractions.Fraction.
reproduction_method.sdp: CVXPY/CLARABEL, absolute and relative gap/feasibility tolerance1e-10. Primal PSD spectral clipping followed by exact-form partial-trace congruence normalization; dual shift by negative minimum slack plus1e-11.
reproduction_method.entropy: 70-digit mpmath harmonic values and exact Binet expression; scaled errors only assess listed finite cases.
reproduction_method.mp_integral: SciPy quadrature of (2/pi)*integral_0^pi sin(theta)^2/sqrt(1+y-2sqrt(y)cos(theta)) dtheta, squared; y=1/c; tolerances2e-13.
